summary: OpenAI and Thailand's Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation launched an eight-week accelerator program to help ten Thai startups in health, wellness and education turn AI prototypes into deployable products, with OpenAI providing API credits, mentorship and access to its frontier models.

mechanisms.reason: The document cites a large stated increase in Codex usage volume in Thailand as part of the AI adoption narrative underlying the accelerator.
mechanisms.quote: Since the start of 2026, weekly active usage of Codex in Thailand has grown more than 350-fold, also placing the country among the top 20 globally for Codex usage.
